Clone an assistant. Creates a new assistant with all the same settings as

assistant is that branch as a standalone assistant: the configuration a
call on the branch runs, with one branch (Main) and one version. ``name``
names it; omitted, it is "<assistant> - <branch>".

get.description:
A branch's configuration: model, voices, both prompts and call settings.

For a GPT-Live branch, `voice_engine` names the voice, the voice model's
own prompt and the delegated model; `config.system_prompt` is the delegated
model's prompt.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: `tip` (what edits build on), `serving` (what calls run), or a version number.

patch.description:
Change a branch's configuration. A new version is written on the
branch and returned. On Main this is the same write as
``PATCH /assistants/{id}``.

To put a branch on GPT-Live, send `tts_settings` whose primary voice has
`provider: "openai-live"` (the voice in `voice`, the voice model's prompt
in `settings.voice_instructions`) and an OpenAI `model` for it to
delegate to; `system_prompt` is the delegated model's prompt. A model,
voice or flow GPT-Live cannot run is refused with 422, naming it.

Required scope: agents:write or *

Start an outbound phone call.

The assistant will handle the conversation once the call is answered.

Calls are made sequentially with an optional delay between each call.

Limits:
- Maximum 100 calls per batch request

post.description:
Create a new campaign.

Mirrors the internal POST /campaigns surface (campaign_type, caller_id_mode,
phone_pool_id, content templates, channel_sequence, content_mode, ...) plus
two external conveniences:
  - inline dialer settings (parallel_lines, dial-attempts, retry interval)
    applied to the new campaign in the same request
  - inline `recipients` list to seed campaign leads on creation

The internal `validate_type_requirements` model_validator (inherited) is
enforced here, so `phone` requires `agent_id`, `sms` requires both a
template and `phone_number_id`, `email` requires both templates, and
`mixed` requires `channel_sequence` with at least 2 steps.

patch.description:
Update campaign settings.

Accepts the full internal `UpdateCampaignSettingsRequest` field surface
(~30 fields incl. webhook_url/headers, pacing_config, extraction_config,
after_hours_config, overflow_config, voicemail_drop_*, content templates,
channel_sequence, stop_on_reply_enabled, agent_id, direction,
phone_pool_id, etc.).

Delegates to the internal route handler so the three guards are enforced
identically:
  1. Reject when campaign.status is `running` or `scheduled`
  2. Validate + normalize timezone via `validate_timezone()`
  3. Reject `parallel_lines > org.max_outbound_concurrent` (or inbound)

services__platform_api__routers__externa.description:
External create-campaign request.

Inherits the full internal `CreateCampaignRequest` field surface + the
`validate_type_requirements` model_validator (phone needs agent_id, sms
needs phone_number_id + message_template, email needs templates, mixed
needs channel_sequence, etc.).

Adds two external-only conveniences:
  - dialer settings inline (internal create has fixed defaults; setting
    these requires a follow-up PATCH /settings)
  - inline `recipients` list (so a single API call can create campaign +
    leads)

`assistant_id` is exposed as an alias for `agent_id` so existing API key
consumers keep working; if both are sent the explicit `agent_id` wins.
services__platform_api__routers__externa.title: services__platform_api__routers__external__campaigns__CreateCampaignRequest
